updates.title: PWA Refresh Bug Fixes
updates.description: Fixed database initialization race conditions and service persistence bugs that caused PWA to fail on normal refresh
changes: Enhanced database initialization with retry logic and timeout protection
Fixed room service persistence - ended services no longer reappear after refresh
Added comprehensive database recovery system for initialization failures
Implemented automatic refresh bug detection and fixing
Enhanced service worker with version broadcasting and cache-busting
Added emergency update mechanisms for critical bug fixes
fixes: Database failed to open errors on normal refresh
PWA initialization failures (worked on hard refresh but not normal refresh)

announcements.title: Refresh Bugs Fixed
announcements.message: The PWA refresh issues have been resolved. The app will now work properly on both normal refresh and hard refresh.
